title: Set up project environment and dependencies
description: Initialize the project with Godot 4.5.1 .NET, .NET 8 SDK, and ensure packages.lock.json is present.
acceptance: task-0001.json must include machine-readable fields for godot_version, dotnet_version, packages_lock_exists, and evidence_paths; missing any field fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1EnvironmentEvidencePersistenceTests.cs

task-0001.json must provide explicit pass/fail conclusions for Windows-only and UTF-8 compliance with traceable evidence sources; vague statements (for example, "checked") fail acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1EnvironmentEvidencePersistenceTests.cs

ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md must list all evidence paths for Task 1, and every path must resolve to an existing file under logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/env-evidence/; any broken path fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1EnvironmentEvidencePersistenceTests.cs

On Windows, GODOT_BIN must be set to the absolute path of the Godot 4.5.1 .NET console executable, and .NET-console flavor must be proven by both executable identity evidence and version-command output captured from that exact path; task-0001.json must record godot_bin_env.env_var_name="GODOT_BIN", godot_bin_env.env_var_value (absolute path), godot_bin_env.env_var_scope (Process/User/Machine), and installation verification result. Missing any required field or non-absolute path fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1ToolchainVersionChecksTests.cs

Must execute `& $env:GODOT_BIN --version`; command must succeed and stdout must include "4.5.1". Running `godot --version` is optional evidence when PATH is configured; if provided, it must also report "4.5.1". Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1ToolchainVersionChecksTests.cs

Must persist full stdout of `& $env:GODOT_BIN --version` to logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/env-evidence/godot-bin-version.txt; when `godot --version` is available, its full stdout must be persisted to logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/env-evidence/godot-version.txt. Missing required evidence file fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1EnvironmentEvidencePersistenceTests.cs

task-0001.json must record command, exit_code, parsed_version, and evidence_file for each Godot version command; missing any key fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1ToolchainVersionChecksTests.cs

After installing .NET 8 SDK, running `dotnet --version` must start with "8.", and `dotnet --list-sdks` must contain at least one 8.x SDK entry; 7.x, 9.x, empty output, missing 8.x SDK entry, or command failure fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1ToolchainVersionChecksTests.cs

If packages.lock.json is missing before restore, running `dotnet restore .\NewRouge.sln` must generate it; if it already exists, it must remain present and correspond to the same NewRouge.sln restore scope. A lock file outside the NewRouge.sln restore scope does not satisfy acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1DotnetRestoreLockfileTests.cs

Before toolchain checks are accepted, `.\NewRouge.sln` must exist in repository workspace and be the exact restore target used in evidence; missing solution file or mismatched restore target fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1DotnetRestoreLockfileTests.cs

Must create logs/ directory structure for evidence, including at minimum logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/env-evidence/, and store readable evidence files covering Godot version checks, dotnet version, dotnet SDK list, packages.lock.json existence, Windows-only result, and UTF-8 result; any missing required directory or evidence file fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1EnvironmentEvidencePersistenceTests.cs

Acceptance artifacts must explicitly back-link ADR-0031 and ADR-0011 (for example via refs in task-0001.json and ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md); missing either ADR reference fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1EnvironmentEvidencePersistenceTests.cs

UTF-8 compliance must be validated at file level: task-0001.json, ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md, and generated evidence files under logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/env-evidence/ must decode as UTF-8 without errors; task-0001.json must include utf8_check.result="pass", utf8_check.checked_files (non-empty), and utf8_check.evidence_file. Any decode failure or missing required field fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1EnvironmentEvidencePersistenceTests.cs

Windows-only is a hard gate: os_platform must be Windows, and task-0001.json must include windows_only_check.result="pass" with platform evidence. Non-Windows or missing evidence fails and must stop downstream gates. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1WindowsPlatformGateTests.cs

Must persist full stdout of `dotnet restore .\NewRouge.sln` to logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/env-evidence/dotnet-restore.txt; missing evidence file fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1DotnetRestoreLockfileTests.cs

task-0001.json must include dotnet_restore.command, dotnet_restore.exit_code, and dotnet_restore.evidence_file; dotnet_restore.command must target NewRouge.sln (semantic equivalent of `dotnet restore .\NewRouge.sln`), and dotnet_restore.exit_code must equal 0. Missing any key, wrong restore target, or non-zero exit_code fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1DotnetRestoreLockfileTests.cs
test_strategy: Check Godot version via 'godot --version', .NET version via 'dotnet --version', and verify packages.lock.json exists. Log environment evidence to logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/env-evidence/. Refs: ADR-0031, ADR-0011.

title: Create core project structure and namespaces
description: Establish directory boundaries: Game.Core, Game.Godot, Game.Core.Tests, Tests.Godot. Enforce NewRouge.* namespace.
acceptance: Repository root must contain Game.Core/, Game.Godot/, Game.Core.Tests/, and Tests.Godot/. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0002_acceptance.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task2NamespaceCoexistenceTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task2RootBuildGateTests.cs

Game.Core/, Game.Core.Tests/, and Tests.Godot/ must each contain a .csproj with TargetFramework=net8.0 and Nullable=enable; Game.Godot/ is a script/resource directory and must not contain any standalone .csproj. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0002_acceptance.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task2RootBuildGateTests.cs

Game.Core must not reference any Godot package or API. taskdoc/task-0002-change-set.json is the authoritative Task 2 C# scope and must include Game.Core/Conventions and Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task2* entries (plus optional Tests.Godot Task2 C# entries); every listed file must declare namespaces under NewRouge.*; legacy Game.* may remain outside Task 2 scope. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0002_acceptance.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task2NamespaceCoexistenceTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task2RootBuildGateTests.cs

If legacy Game.* namespaces are present, they may coexist with NewRouge.*; Task 2 does not require full repository rename. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task2NamespaceCoexistenceTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task2RootBuildGateTests.cs

Task 2 completion must include sc-acceptance-check step `dotnet-build-warnaserror` with exit_code=0 as root build proof; if this gate is not executed or fails, Task 2 must remain non-done and progression must be blocked. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task2RootBuildGateTests.cs
test_strategy: Validate root directories and .csproj settings for Game.Core, Game.Core.Tests, and Tests.Godot; treat Game.Godot as script/resource directory. Refs: ADR-0024.
Gate evidence: root build pass is enforced by sc-acceptance-check dotnet-build-warnaserror (exit code 0, no compiler errors), and Task2RootBuildGateTests validates build output classification.
Evidence note: structure snapshot may be stored as logs/ci/<date>/task-0002-structure.txt for review traceability.
Evidence note: capture sc-acceptance-check summary at logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/sc-acceptance-check-task-2/summary.json and keep dotnet-build-warnaserror step status for audit (non-Refs evidence).

title: Implement core contracts for card identity and forms
description: Define contracts in Game.Core/Contracts for card identity, forms (Base, U1A, U1B, Ultimate), and upgrade fields per ADR-0033.
acceptance: 在 Game.Core/Contracts 中定义 CardDefinition 与 CardInstance 契约：CardDefinition 至少包含 card_id，CardInstance 至少包含 instance_id、upgrade_tier、upgrade_route、permanent_card_instance_modifiers；并定义 Form 枚举（Base/U1A/U1B/Ultimate）与 Route 枚举（A/B）。上述契约需可被纯 .NET 测试项目直接引用并编译通过，且不得依赖任何 Godot 类型或命名空间。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0003AcceptanceTests.cs

升级语义必须可被测试直接判定：当 upgrade_tier=2 时，upgrade_route 必须为 null；当 upgrade_tier 不为 2 且提供 upgrade_route 时，其值仅允许 A 或 B。对违反“tier=2 且 route 非 null”的输入，测试必须产生显式失败结果，且不能通过跳过断言、空测试、默认值回退或静默修正掩盖问题。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0003AcceptanceTests.cs
在 Game.Core.Tests/Contracts 下新增或更新 xUnit 测试，覆盖契约字段定义、Form/Route 枚举成员完整性、以及 tier=2→route=null 约束的正反两类用例；并验证测试工程保持纯 .NET 依赖且未引入 Godot 依赖。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0003AcceptanceTests.cs

In Game.Core/Contracts, CardDefinition and CardInstance must be interface or class (record class allowed); reflection tests assert IsInterface or IsClass and reject other shapes. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0003AcceptanceTests.cs

Game.Core.Tests/Contracts must include reflection assertions that CardDefinition and CardInstance are IsInterface or IsClass (including record class); any other type shape fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0003AcceptanceTests.cs

Negative tests must assert explicit failure when CardDefinition or CardInstance is struct, enum, or any non interface/class shape; missing negative gate fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0003AcceptanceTests.cs
test_strategy: Write xUnit tests in Game.Core.Tests/Contracts to validate contract definitions and upgrade field constraints. Ensure no Godot dependencies. Refs: ADR-0033, ADR-0020.

title: Implement core contracts for offer locking and deterministic outcomes
description: Define contracts for offer locking structure, provenance, and RNG streams per ADR-0032 and Design Gate 05.
acceptance: Contracts layer provides concrete C# types `OfferLockSnapshot` and `OfferProvenance` that can be instantiated in tests; a schema-only or dictionary-only representation does not satisfy this requirement. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingContractTests.cs

`OfferLockSnapshot` includes `stable_ids`, `display_order`, `provenance`, `rng_stream`, and `locked_at_save_point` semantics (implemented as `IsLockedAtSavePoint`), and `Provenance` remains intact through value-object round-trip serialization/deserialization. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingContractTests.cs

`OfferProvenance` includes `source_type`, `source_id`, `act`, `floor`, `node_id`, `difficulty`, `rng_stream`, and `stream_pos` with contract-visible field/type definitions that tests can verify. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingContractTests.cs
In valid constructed samples, `OfferLockSnapshot.rng_stream` equals `OfferProvenance.rng_stream`; any mismatch fails contract validation. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingContractTests.cs
Offer-lock snapshots preserve `provenance.stream_pos` and explicitly carry save-point lock context as a boolean semantic. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingContractTests.cs

RNG stream categories are a closed set of `run`, `combat`, `event`, `loot`, `shop`, and `offer`; `OfferLockSnapshot.RngStream` and `OfferProvenance.RngStream` accept only this set, and unknown values fail validation tests. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/RngStreamTypeTests.cs, Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingContractTests.cs
`stable_ids` are content-stable IDs, and changing only `display_order` does not change the `stable_ids` set. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingDeterminismTests.cs

`locked_at_save_point` is represented by explicit boolean semantics (`IsLockedAtSavePoint`) and is reproducible for the same lock context; any optional `LockedAt` timestamp is informational only. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingContractTests.cs

Serialization/deserialization round-trip preserves full `OfferLockSnapshot` data; identical inputs (including `rng_stream` and `stream_pos`) produce identical outputs, and when `rng_stream` or `stream_pos` changes, `stable_ids` remain content-stable while provenance reflects the changed context. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingDeterminismTests.cs

For identical lock inputs (context, candidates, provenance, save-point flag), deterministic retrieval returns equivalent snapshots for `StableIds`, `DisplayOrder`, `Provenance.RngStream`, `Provenance.StreamPosition`, and `IsLockedAtSavePoint`. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingContractTests.cs
test_strategy: Write xUnit tests to validate offer locking structure and provenance fields. Test serialization/deserialization for deterministic behavior. Refs: ADR-0032.

title: Implement core contracts for status and modifier system
description: Define contracts for status types (Buff, Debuff, RuleModifier), fields, and deterministic ordering per Design Gate 04.
acceptance: 可通过契约与测试断言验证：StatusType 必须包含 Buff、Debuff、RuleModifier，且必须定义 ExpiresTiming；Status 必须包含 status_id、stacks、duration_turns、source_id、expires_timing、strength 字段；对同一输入集合按 stable_id 排序时，多次执行得到完全一致的顺序；执行驱散后 RuleModifier 与 status.strength 相关效果仍保留。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0005AcceptanceTests.cs
对同一初始状态执行同一操作序列时，Status 的叠加、duration_turns 累计与衰减结果必须一致且可断言；当某次操作前置条件不满足时，执行后状态必须与执行前完全一致。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0005AcceptanceTests.cs
xUnit 测试必须覆盖叠加规则、持续时长处理、驱散边界（含 RuleModifier 与 strength 不可驱散）以及 stable_id 排序确定性；任一规则被破坏时，至少一个对应测试用例失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0005AcceptanceTests.cs
Status 契约必须提供叠加、持续时长累计、衰减三个可调用方法（命名可等价）；每个方法都必须能通过调用后的状态变化（或按规则不变化）直接断言，任一方法缺失、不可访问或不可断言即失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0005AcceptanceTests.cs
ADR-0021 and ADR-0029 must be present in task=5 adr_refs of both tasks_back.json and tasks_gameplay.json; any missing or mismatch must fail. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0005AcceptanceTests.cs

ADR-0021 and ADR-0029 listed in ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md section "Task5 ADR Mapping" must exactly match task=5 adr_refs in both task views; any mismatch must fail. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0005AcceptanceTests.cs
驱散边界必须可观测：当同一集合同时包含可驱散状态与 RuleModifier 或 status.strength 相关效果时，驱散后仅可驱散状态被移除，RuleModifier 与 status.strength 相关效果保持不变；若任一不可驱散效果被移除则判定失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0005AcceptanceTests.cs
test_strategy: Write xUnit tests for status operations: stacking, duration handling, and dispel boundaries. Validate deterministic ordering via stable_id sorting. Refs: ADR-0021, ADR-0029.

title: Implement core contracts for combat loop and resolution pipeline
description: Define contracts for combat phases, damage calculation, and deterministic sequencing per Design Gates 01 and 03.
acceptance: Deliverables provide executable contracts for four scopes: CombatLoop phases, PlayCard resolution pipeline, damage calculation rules, and the OverplayTax difficulty threshold. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs

xUnit contains behavioral assertions for phase transitions, pipeline order and short-circuit behavior, damage rules, OverplayTax threshold behavior, and deterministic execution. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs

Referenced test files contain executable assertions that prove Task6 contract obligations; stale, missing, or non-executable references fail semantic acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
CombatLoop contract exposes exactly four phases: StartOfTurn, Draw, Main, EndOfTurn; any missing or extra phase fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs

PlayCard pipeline contract enforces the exact canonical sequence Validate->ComputeCost->PayCost->BeforePlayTriggers->ResolveEffect->AfterPlayTriggers->MoveCard->DeathCheck, with no missing, extra, or reordered steps. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs

Damage contract applies Strength, Weak, and Vulnerable multipliers to mutable damage, and fixed damage remains exempt from mutable multipliers. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/ValueObjects/DamageTests.cs
OverplayTax is applied only when difficulty >= 10 and is not applied when difficulty < 10, with explicit boundary assertions. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
Deterministic ordering uses combatant_id and stable_id to produce stable sequence output, and repeated runs with the same input stay identical. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs

Task6 test suite includes both positive and negative paths for transitions, pipeline behavior, damage rules, OverplayTax behavior, and deterministic outcomes. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Domain/ValueObjects/DamageTests.cs
Phase transition guards reject invalid transitions and preserve unchanged combat state when rejection occurs. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs

Task6 contract behavior must stay consistent with ADR-0021 (state machine boundaries) and ADR-0032 (determinism), and tests must assert that alignment. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0006CombatContractsTraceabilityTests.cs
When Validate fails, pipeline execution stops at Validate and does not execute ComputeCost or later steps, with critical state unchanged. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
xUnit includes an explicit Validate-failure case asserting that step trace stops at Validate and state remains unchanged. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
Tests assert both valid and invalid phase transition behavior, including guard rejection and unchanged state on invalid transitions. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/State/CombatLoopPhaseTransitionTests.cs
Tests cover the OverplayTax boundary at difficulty 9 and 10 with explicit assertions for not-applied versus applied taxed-cost behavior. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
All deterministic cases produce identical outputs for identical inputs and identical initial state, independent of run count. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
[OBL:T6.O10] Damage coverage executes a representative input matrix that proves multiplier and fixed-damage behavior across scenarios. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/ValueObjects/DamageTests.cs

[OBL:T6.O10] Multiplier and fixed-damage scenarios include normal cases, boundary cases, and negative/invalid inputs. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/ValueObjects/DamageTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
[OBL:T6.O10] Table-driven damage tests verify multiplier math, fixed-damage invariants, and deterministic numeric outputs. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/ValueObjects/DamageTests.cs
[OBL:T6.O15] CombatLoop is implemented as an instantiable C# contract type in Game.Core and is directly usable by tests. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
[OBL:T6.O15] Contract completion requires executable behavior verified by tests, not descriptive-only declarations. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
[OBL:T6.O15] CombatLoop implementation is located under Game.Core/Contracts/Combat and referenced by tests. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
PlayCard resolution applies OverplayTax during ComputeCost and consumes the taxed cost in PayCost when difficulty >= 10. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
When ComputeCost or PayCost fails, pipeline stops immediately at the failing step and keeps critical combat state unchanged. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs

For the same PlayCardPipelineInput and the same initial state, repeated runs produce identical ExecutedSteps, StateAfter, and ExecutionFingerprint. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs

When any post-cost step (BeforePlayTriggers, ResolveEffect, AfterPlayTriggers, MoveCard, DeathCheck) fails, execution stops at the failing step and keeps critical combat state unchanged. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs

PlayCard pipeline and damage calculation are defined as explicit executable contract types under Game.Core/Contracts/Combat (or subfolders), and tests reference those contract types directly rather than only service-side implicit behavior. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Domain/ValueObjects/DamageTests.cs

Deterministic sequencing contract defines comparator precedence (combatant_id first, stable_id second) and deterministic tie handling for equal keys, and tests assert this rule explicitly. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
test_strategy: Write xUnit tests for combat phase transitions, damage calculation, and OverplayTax application. Ensure deterministic ordering via combatant_id and stable_id. Refs: ADR-0021, ADR-0032.

title: Set up event bus and contracts location
description: Implement event bus system and place contracts in Game.Core/Contracts per ADR-0004 and ADR-0020.
acceptance: 在 `Game.Core/Contracts` 下存在事件总线接口，并暴露可调用的发布与订阅方法；该目录是契约唯一来源，Godot 层仅通过引用使用，不能新增或复制同类契约定义。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0007AcceptanceTests.cs
提供 xUnit 用例，能够实际验证“发布后可被订阅方接收”的行为（失败时会红灯）；并且在 Windows 上执行 `dotnet test` 通过。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0007AcceptanceTests.cs
docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md 的 Test-Refs 指向本任务新增或更新的 xUnit 用例路径。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0007AcceptanceTests.cs
在 `Game.Core/Contracts` 中定义 `CardPlayed` 与 `CombatStarted` 事件 DTO，且每个 DTO 含有可区分事件类型的常量或字段。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/GameEventContractsTests.cs
在组合根完成 `EventBus` 依赖注入注册；Godot 层通过接口解析并可实际调用该 `EventBus`。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Adapters/test_event_bus_adapter.gd
Godot 层在发布/订阅时使用 `Game.Core.Contracts` 中的 DTO 类型；仓库中不存在 Godot 层新增的同名契约定义文件。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Adapters/test_event_bus_adapter.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0007AcceptanceTests.cs
通过自动化测试或可复现检索证据可确认：契约文件位于 `Game.Core/Contracts`，且 Godot 层无重复 DTO 定义。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Utilities/ContractsLocationAndDuplicationTests.cs

EventBus 验收需验证以下领域事件均可发布且可订阅：`core.combat.started`、`core.combat.card.played`、`core.reward.offer.locked`、`core.autosave.written`、`core.run.state.transitioned`；任一事件未被验证即验收失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0007AcceptanceTests.cs
test_strategy: Write xUnit tests for event publishing and subscription. Verify contracts are in correct location and not duplicated in Godot scripts. Refs: ADR-0004, ADR-0020.

title: Implement core logic for card identity and forms
description: Create core services for card definition, instance management, and form transitions per ADR-0033.
acceptance: CardService 必须对外提供按 card_id 获取定义、创建实例、执行 U1 升级与推进到 Ultimate 的能力；合法输入产生可断言的形态/层级结果，非法输入返回确定性失败且实例状态不变。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardServiceTests.cs
按 card_id 查询定义时，命中返回唯一对应 CardDefinition；未命中必须产生可重复验证的确定性失败（同类输入得到同类失败输出）。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardServiceTests.cs
创建 CardInstance 时必须初始化 instance_id、base form 和修饰符容器，并保证实例身份与 CardDefinition 身份分离（实例变更不影响定义）。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardServiceTests.cs
实例在升级与 Ultimate 形态迁移后，permanent_card_instance_modifiers 必须按继承语义完整保留并可测试比对；若迁移被拒绝，修饰符与形态保持原值。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardServiceTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Domain/CardInstanceTests.cs
upgrade_tier 与 upgrade_route 必须联合校验，U1 仅接受受支持的 tier/route 组合；非法组合触发硬失败且形态、层级、修饰符均不变化。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardServiceTests.cs
xUnit 测试覆盖卡牌身份、card_id 查找命中/未命中、U1 路线升级、Ultimate 进阶与修饰符继承，并在测试描述中显式引用 ADR-0033。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardServiceTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Domain/ValueObjects/CardIdentityTests.cs
与本任务对应的 xUnit 用例应能直接定位并复现上述断言，覆盖 card identity、upgrade path 与 modifier inheritance。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardServiceTests.cs

When a card enters Ultimate form, Ultimate must become the active form for that instance and subsequent behavior must be resolved from the Ultimate form state. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardServiceTests.cs
Ultimate transition must preserve existing permanent_card_instance_modifiers on the same card instance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardServiceTests.cs
xUnit must verify card_id lookup hit and miss behavior with deterministic failure outputs. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardServiceTests.cs

CardDefinition and CardInstance contract fields required by instance creation must be non-empty/valid and assertion-readable in tests. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Contracts/CardContractsTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Contracts/ContractInstantiationCoverageTests.cs
xUnit must verify deterministic mapping from each allowed form transition to its observable effect description key/output. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardServiceTests.cs
xUnit must verify route constraints and tier-route invariants for all legal and illegal inputs. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardServiceTests.cs
[OBL:T8.O10] 创建 CardInstance 后，实例字段必须与合同字段一一对应；缺失或额外字段均判失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Contracts/ContractInstantiationCoverageTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Contracts/CardContractsTests.cs
[OBL:T8.O10] 对合同字段的默认值与类型进行可重复断言。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Contracts/CardContractsTests.cs

存在有效 autosave 时点击 New Run 必须弹出覆盖确认对话框，默认焦点在取消；选择取消时 autosave 保持不变。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_main_menu_new_run_overwrite_cancel.gd Tests.Godot/tests/UI/test_main_menu_confirm_dialog_focus.gd

点击 Quit 必须触发退出流程并关闭应用，不得无动作停留在主菜单。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/UI/test_main_menu_events.gd
必须提供主菜单 UI 流程的手动测试记录，覆盖 New Run 覆盖确认与 Continue 有效 autosave。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0014_acceptance.gd
手动测试记录必须可审计（文件或清单可访问）。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0014_acceptance.gd
验收项需检查 ADR-0032 与 ADR-0010 的引用或回链。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0014_acceptance.gd
test_strategy: Manual testing of UI flow: new run with overwrite confirm, continue when autosave exists. Write GdUnit4 tests for button interactions and translation loading. Refs: ADR-0032, ADR-0010.

title: Implement difficulty selection UI
description: Create DifficultySelect.tscn with 10 difficulty levels and descriptions per M1 requirements.
acceptance: 进入难度选择界面后，难度选择控件必须可见且可操作，难度选项数量恒为10个（不是9或11）；用户在界面内切换选项时，当前选中状态必须即时可见。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0015_acceptance.gd
10个难度选项都必须显示说明文本；说明文本仅表达数值挑战强度，不得暗示与天赋树强绑定；显示文本必须来自本地化/翻译资源。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0015_acceptance.gd
用户确认难度后，所选难度必须写入全局状态；再次进入难度选择界面或相关界面时必须读取并显示该值；在未进行新的确认选择前，该值不得自行变化。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0015_acceptance.gd
必须支持键盘/鼠标或手柄在10个难度选项间导航并完成确认；确认后界面当前选中项与最终生效难度必须一致。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/UI/test_difficulty_select_input_navigation.gd Tests.Godot/tests/UI/test_difficulty_select_confirm_selection.gd
难度选择交互形态必须为按钮组或滑块之一，且该控件必须能够覆盖并选中全部10级难度。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0015_acceptance.gd
必须提供UI导航测试用例，覆盖键盘/鼠标/手柄输入下的难度选择流程，并对导航结果与确认结果进行断言。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0015_acceptance.gd
必须提供难度持久化测试用例，验证确认选择后重新进入界面仍读取并显示已选难度，且在无新选择时不会被静默重置为默认值。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0015_acceptance.gd
必须提供可审计用例，验证说明文本不暗示与天赋树强绑定，并可在UI或本地化资源层定位并检查对应文本。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0015_acceptance.gd
test_strategy: Test UI navigation and difficulty persistence. Verify descriptions do not imply strong binding to talent tree. Refs: ADR-0010, ADR-0032.

title: Implement character selection UI for Warrior only
description: Create CharacterSelect.tscn with Warrior as only selectable character and mechanism summary per M1 requirements.
acceptance: 在 CharacterSelect.tscn 中仅 Warrior 可进入可选/选中状态；其余角色必须隐藏或置灰并显示“not open”标签，且尝试交互时这些角色状态不发生变化。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0016_acceptance.gd
在 Windows 环境打开 CharacterSelect.tscn 时，界面可成功加载并显示 Warrior 选项，且可完成至少一次对 Warrior 的选择交互。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0016_acceptance.gd
Overlay 的 Test-Refs 清单包含本任务用例并保持可追踪。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0016_acceptance.gd
Warrior 的机制摘要必须显示为三行可见文本，三行语义分别覆盖：怒气作为状态增益、强力攻击窗口、代价与爆发。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/CharacterSelect/test_character_select_warrior_summary.gd
机制摘要三行文本必须来自翻译键而非硬编码；切换语言后三行内容同步变化。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/UI/test_settings_locale.gd
除 Warrior 外其他角色不可被选中；点击或键盘操作这些角色时，不触发其选中状态变化。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/CharacterSelect/test_character_select_locked_characters_unselectable.gd
gameplay:X: “not open”标签必须来自翻译键，切换语言时其文本同步变化。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0016_acceptance.gd
test_strategy: Verify Warrior selection works and other characters are not selectable. Check translation keys for mechanism summary. Refs: ADR-0010.

title: Create modular Act structure for map system
description: Implement map system with modular Act structure, not hardcoded to 3 Acts, per M1 requirements.
acceptance: 地图在Act数量配置为2、4、5时均能完成构建与导航初始化，且不会因固定3个Act假设而失败；自动化验收至少验证一个非3-Act配置通过。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0017_acceptance.gd
在Windows环境执行验收时，地图初始化、节点展示、分叉选择流程均可完成；对同一输入重复执行产生一致的可观察结果，否则判定不通过。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0017_acceptance.gd
Overlay中的Test-Refs可直接定位到本任务的地图导航与Act结构测试文件；若ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST中的对应路径不存在或无法核对通过状态，则判定不通过。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0017_acceptance.gd
Game.Core中的MapService对Act与地图节点进行管理，并在固定输入下可稳定断言节点集合、连接关系与状态变化，且对应xUnit测试通过。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/MapServiceTests.cs
Map.tscn可识别到Combat、Event、Shop、Rest四类节点图标或等价可识别表现；缺失任一类型即判定不通过。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Map/test_map_node_icons_presence.gd
地图支持分叉选择：同一初始状态下选择不同分支后，可达节点集合或后续路径至少存在一处可观察差异；若无差异则判定不通过。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/MapBranchSelectionTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Map/test_map_branch_selection_paths.gd
进入任一节点前必须保存node_pre_enter状态；进入后可通过读取状态或测试断言确认其已保存且与进入前一致，未保存或不一致即判定失败。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Map/test_map_node_pre_enter_state.gd
存在xUnit用例验证Act结构可按配置数量运行且不依赖固定3个Act；用例能区分满足条件时成功与不满足条件时失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/MapActConfigurationTests.cs
存在可重复执行的用例验证地图导航与节点选择，至少覆盖一次有效节点选择及其状态转移结果，并能稳定复现。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/MapNavigationSelectionTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_map_navigation_state_transitions.gd
验收材料或变更记录中可检索到ADR-0007与ADR-0021的引用，并能对应到本任务的MapService与地图契约决策；缺失任一引用即判定不通过。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0017_acceptance.gd
[OBL:T17.O8] 在分叉节点提交非法分支ID时，系统必须拒绝该次选择，且当前节点与可达节点集合保持不变。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/MapServiceTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Map/test_map_fork_invalid_branch_rejected.gd
[OBL:T17.O8] 对同一非法输入重复执行时结果必须一致，并可通过xUnit或Godot测试断言未发生状态推进。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Map/test_map_fork_invalid_branch_rejected.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0017AcceptanceTests.cs

[OBL:T17.O8] 分叉选择接收无效分支输入时必须拒绝前进，且当前导航状态保持不变（must not advance / state unchanged）。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/MapServiceTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Map/test_map_fork_invalid_branch_rejected.gd
test_strategy: Test map navigation and node selection. Write xUnit tests for Act structure modularity. Refs: ADR-0007, ADR-0021.

title: Implement combat scene UI shell and bindings
description: Create Combat.tscn UI layout and bind to core combat state.
acceptance: 加载 Combat.tscn 后，场景内必须存在且默认可见用于手牌、能量、抽牌堆、弃牌堆与回合控制（开始/结束或等价控制）的 HUD 元素，并可被自动化测试稳定定位。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd
当注入核心战斗状态快照时，Combat.tscn 的 UI 显示必须与状态逐项一致：手牌列表、当前能量值、抽牌堆数量、弃牌堆数量均可被逐项断言；若显示固定占位值或与快照不一致则验收失败。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd
当核心战斗状态发生变化（如手牌增减、能量变化、牌堆计数变化）时，现有 UI 必须同步反映新值；相同输入状态必须产生相同显示结果，且可通过可观察输出或自动化断言验证。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd
本场景仅负责回合控制 UI 外壳与命令派发边界：交互事件必须路由至命令处理器，场景层不得直接变更核心状态、执行规则结算或推进完整回合；在无外部流程接管或动作为无效时，状态保持不变且不得自行推进回合。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_turn_control_localization_smoke.gd

提供 GdUnit4 用例，至少覆盖 Combat.tscn 关键 UI 组件存在性与默认可见、对核心状态读取与变更同步、回合控制交互派发与无效动作阻止、可见文本通过本地化键解析，以及 headless 冒烟可执行路径。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_turn_control_localization_smoke.gd
Task 18 的验收必须包含可审计的架构边界检查并对齐 ADR-0022 与 ADR-0010（UI shell boundary、state-binding boundary、no scene-responsibility overflow）；缺失任一检查即验收失败。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0018_acceptance.gd
Task 18 的验收必须包含可审计的测试策略检查并对齐 ADR-0025（test layering、assertion granularity、failure output quality、reproducible gates）；缺少策略证据即验收失败。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0018_acceptance.gd
test_strategy: GdUnit4 tests for UI presence and bindings to state. Refs: ADR-0025.

title: Implement reward scene with card three-choice-one and offer locking
description: Create Reward.tscn with three card choices, offer locking, and deterministic display per ADR-0032.
acceptance: 进入 Reward.tscn 后，界面必须同时且仅出现 3 张可选择卡牌；若数量不等于 3 或任一卡缺少名称、描述、形态标识（Base/U1A/U1B/Ultimate）则不通过。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Reward/test_reward_scene_three_cards_rendered.gd

在同一轮奖励展示内，玩家仅能成功确认 1 张卡牌；首张确认成功后其余 2 张必须立即变为不可确认，且任何后续确认输入都不得产生第二次成功结果。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Reward/test_reward_scene_single_confirm_lock.gd Game.Core.Tests/Services/RewardSelectionServiceTests.cs

该轮奖励首次展示时必须锁定当前 offer 并写入自动存档；在未生成新 offer 的前提下，退出并重新进入后展示的三卡内容与顺序必须与首次展示一致。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/RewardOfferLockingServiceTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_reward_offer_lock_persist_reenter.gd
执行“跳过”后 RNG 状态必须不前进；在未生成新 offer 的前提下再次进入奖励界面时，必须仍展示同一组三卡。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/RewardOfferRngStateTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Reward/test_reward_scene_skip_preserves_offer.gd
奖励界面所有可见文案必须来自翻译资源；若出现任何硬编码业务文案则不通过。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/UI/test_reward_ui_translations.gd
必须存在 xUnit 用例覆盖 offer 锁定逻辑，并验证退出后再次进入时仍读取并展示同一 offer。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/RewardOfferLockingServiceTests.cs

必须存在覆盖奖励展示、单选确认与跳过流程的验证用例，并包含退出后再次进入仍保持同一 offer 的场景断言。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Reward/test_reward_scene_confirm_and_skip_flow.gd Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_reward_offer_lock_persist_reenter.gd

Task 19 implementation and test artifacts must explicitly trace to ADR-0032 and ADR-0010 (for example in refs fields, checklist mapping, or test annotations); missing either ADR id fails acceptance. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0019_acceptance.gd

Task 19 acceptance must include an auto-checkable ADR linkage gate that verifies ADR-0032 and ADR-0010 are both present and consistent across task evidence; any mismatch fails acceptance. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0019_acceptance.gd
test_strategy: Test reward display, selection, and skip. Verify offer locking by exiting and re-entering. Write xUnit tests for offer locking logic. Refs: ADR-0032, ADR-0010.

title: Implement shop scene with inventory locking and no upgrade context
description: Create Shop.tscn with purchasable items, inventory locking, and no upgrade services per M1 requirements.
acceptance: 进入商店时必须加载 Shop.tscn，并展示可购买的卡牌与遗物及其价格；该次进入的库存与价格在会话内保持锁定，退出后再次进入时除已购买条目外，其余条目与价格必须与首次锁定结果一致。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0020_acceptance.gd
在商店完成购买后，被购买条目必须立即从可购列表移除并标记为已购买/已拥有；商店必须提供且可执行移除与重铸服务，同时不得出现任何升级/Upgrade 服务入口或按钮，且相关 UI 文案来自本地化系统并不含升级语境。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0020_acceptance.gd
overlays 08 的验收清单必须登记本任务 Test-Refs，且这些引用可定位到覆盖商店购买、库存锁定、无升级文案三类行为的测试项。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0020_acceptance.gd
进入商店后形成的库存锁定状态与已购买记录必须被持久化；退出并再次进入时，商店展示结果必须与该持久化状态一致。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0020_acceptance.gd
必须提供测试覆盖商店购买与退出再进入后的库存持久化行为，并在验收清单中登记对应测试引用。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0020_acceptance.gd
验收必须包含测试断言：商店 UI 文本与本地化内容均不出现升级/Upgrade 字样或等价语境。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0020_acceptance.gd
任务测试需实际验证商店 UI 不包含任何升级/Upgrade 相关文案或入口提示。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0020_acceptance.gd
test_strategy: Test shop purchases and inventory persistence on exit/re-enter. Verify UI lacks upgrade wording. Refs: ADR-0032, ADR-0010.

title: Implement rest scene with free upgrade option
description: Create Rest.tscn with options including free card upgrade per M1 requirements.
acceptance: 进入 Rest.tscn 时，界面必须同时显示且可选择“升级（免费升级一张卡）”“治疗”“移除诅咒”三项；任一选项缺失、不可见或不可选择即判定失败。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0021_acceptance.gd
选择“升级”后，流程必须按“选择一张可升级卡→在 Route A 与 Route B 中二选一→进入确认步骤”推进；在确认前取消时，所有卡牌与资源状态必须保持不变且不得产生命中升级结果。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0021_acceptance.gd
升级确认中的不可逆提示必须通过翻译键渲染为有效文案，界面不得显示键名、占位符或异常回退文本；出现任一情况即失败。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0021_acceptance.gd
完成升级确认后必须满足“免费升级”语义：不得触发任何支付流程，且不得减少任何可计量资源；若出现收费提示、支付入口或资源扣减则失败。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Rest/test_rest_upgrade_no_cost_no_resource_deduction.gd
升级一经确认，在同一流程内必须不可撤销、不可回退且不可恢复为升级前状态；若存在可逆路径或不可逆结果不成立则失败. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Rest/test_rest_upgrade_confirmation_irreversible.gd
升级确认后必须且仅有被选中的单张卡牌发生升级变化，其他卡牌状态保持不变；若出现未选中卡牌变化或多张卡牌同时变化则判定失败。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0021_acceptance.gd
在单次 Rest 场景会话内，免费升级确认最多只能发生一次；首次确认后，升级入口必须被禁用或阻止再次进入。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0021AcceptanceTests.cs
若用户在同一 Rest 会话中尝试第二次进入升级流程，系统必须拒绝该操作，并保持所有卡牌与资源状态不变。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0021AcceptanceTests.cs
门禁汇总必须包含 `adr_refs=["ADR-0033", "ADR-0010"]` 且与任务元数据完全一致；缺失或不一致时门禁必须非零退出。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0021_acceptance.gd
门禁汇总必须包含 `chapter_refs=["CH01", "CH06", "CH10", "CH07", "CH05"]` 且与任务元数据完全一致；缺失或不一致时门禁必须非零退出。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0021_acceptance.gd
本任务 `test_refs` 列出的关键测试与工件必须在本轮执行并输出 `executed/pass_fail` 状态；任一未执行或失败即任务失败。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0021_acceptance.gd
若本任务存在可选开关，未启用时必须记录 `executed=false` 与 `pass_fail="skipped"`，且不得被记为通过。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0021_acceptance.gd
对于任一必填回链字段、测试证据或工件校验缺失，门禁必须 fail-closed 且非零退出，不得降级为 warning。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0021_acceptance.gd
test_strategy: Test upgrade flow and confirmation. Verify upgrade is free and irreversible. Check translation keys. Refs: ADR-0033, ADR-0010.

title: Implement event scene with dark cost examples
description: Create Event.tscn with at least two options and dark cost examples (HP loss, curse card) per M1 requirements.
acceptance: 进入 Event.tscn 时必须同时显示事件标题与描述，并提供不少于两个可选项；同一事件中必须可验证地包含“立即HP损失”与“加入诅咒牌”两类 dark cost 示例，任一类型缺失即判定不通过。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0022_acceptance.gd
每次进入事件时，本次可选项集合必须在进入时即锁定且不发生刷新/替换；玩家一旦作出选择，结果必须立即写入，并在退出后再次进入时保持已选状态且不可改选。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0022_acceptance.gd
事件标题、描述、选项文本必须全部由翻译系统提供；切换语言后三类文本必须同步变化且变化结果可被验证。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0022_acceptance.gd
选择“HP损失”代价选项后，当前HP必须在该次选择后立刻减少到可验证的新数值；若HP未变化则判定失败。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Event/test_event_scene_hp_loss_cost_applies_immediately.gd

title: Implement rage as state buff for Warrior
description: Implement rage as a combat-only state buff for Warrior and integrate with status system.
acceptance: 仅在战斗上下文中，战士怒气作为 Buff 状态存在；回合结束时怒气值保持不变（不得自然衰减）；战斗结束后怒气必须重置为 0 且处于无怒气状态。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0025AcceptanceTests.cs
怒气仅可由既定来源产生并按既定叠层规则变化；与其他状态共同结算时，在相同输入下必须得到相同结算顺序与相同最终结果。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0025AcceptanceTests.cs
怒气必须进入战斗伤害计算流水线：存在怒气时伤害结果应体现 Buff 影响；战斗结束并清零怒气后，相同条件下伤害结果必须回到无怒气基线。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0025AcceptanceTests.cs
必须提供并通过 xUnit 用例覆盖怒气叠层、跨回合保持、战斗结束清零三类行为；任一行为不满足时测试必须失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0025AcceptanceTests.cs
验收清单需明确对应测试文件路径与断言要点，使评审者可按路径复现并核对怒气相关结果。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0025AcceptanceTests.cs
必须提供 xUnit 用例验证怒气与其他状态的确定性结算：相同输入重复执行时必须产生相同顺序与相同最终结果，不允许出现非确定性漂移。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0025AcceptanceTests.cs

Review gate must verify implementation and tests reference ADR-0033 and ADR-0021 consistently and audibly; inconsistent ADR mapping fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0025AcceptanceTests.cs
test_strategy: xUnit tests for Rage stacking, persistence across turns, and reset after combat end. Verify deterministic ordering with other statuses. Refs: ADR-0033.

acceptance: 核心层必须暴露 DifficultyConfig 的只读访问；返回数据包含 difficulty_id、label_key、description_key、ruleset_id 四字段且四字段均可读取，调用方不能通过该访问入口修改字段值。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0026_acceptance.gd
开始一次 run 时必须选择难度（仅允许 1-10）并写入该 run 的元数据；run 开始后对难度的任何修改请求不得改变已记录值（保持原值或被明确拒绝）。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0026_acceptance.gd
验收清单中必须记录并指向与“难度配置持久化与不可变性”相关的测试引用项。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0026_acceptance.gd
验收清单必须指向 xUnit 测试文件，覆盖难度写入 run 元数据的验证。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0026AcceptanceTests.cs
验收清单必须指向 xUnit 测试文件，覆盖 run 开始后难度不可变（拒绝或值不变）的验证。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0026AcceptanceTests.cs
xUnit tests must assert that the selected difficulty value is persisted into run metadata at run start. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0026AcceptanceTests.cs
xUnit tests verify difficulty is immutable after run start (reject or value unchanged). Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0026AcceptanceTests.cs

At run start, run metadata must contain all four selected DifficultyConfig fields (difficulty_id, label_key, description_key, ruleset_id); if any field is missing, acceptance fails. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0026AcceptanceTests.cs

Acceptance tests must assert field-by-field equality between persisted run metadata and the selected DifficultyConfig snapshot; any mismatch fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0026AcceptanceTests.cs

After run start, mutation requests for these four persisted fields must be rejected and stored values must remain unchanged; any mutable field fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0026AcceptanceTests.cs
Task 26 acceptance checklist must explicitly include ADR-0023, ADR-0032, and ADR-0021 trace links; missing any ADR id fails acceptance. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0026_acceptance.gd

Gate validation for Task 26 must fail when ADR-0023/ADR-0032/ADR-0021 traceability is incomplete or inconsistent across checklist and task evidence outputs. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0026_acceptance.gd
test_strategy: xUnit tests for difficulty persistence and immutability after run start. Refs: ADR-0032.

对于任一必填回链字段、测试证据或工件校验缺失，门禁必须 fail-closed 且非零退出，不得降级为 warning。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0027AcceptanceTests.cs

title: Create ActConfig data model and loader
description: Define ActConfig and load Act data from JSON for modular acts.
acceptance: ActConfig is defined in Game.Core with schema_version, act_id, node_graph, pools, and encounters; loading a valid Act JSON yields matching field values without implicit normalization or rewrite. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0028AcceptanceTests.cs
ActConfig is loaded from an Act data file via System.Text.Json; for a valid input, the result is IsSuccess=true and Config is non-null. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0028AcceptanceTests.cs

If file read fails, JSON parsing fails, or required fields are missing, the result is IsSuccess=false, Config=null, with a stable ErrorCode and non-empty ErrorMessage. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0028AcceptanceTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Services/ActConfigLoaderTests.cs

schema_version must be present and supported; missing, unknown, or incompatible versions fail with an assertable error outcome. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/ActConfigLoaderSchemaVersionTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0028AcceptanceTests.cs
xUnit tests verify successful loading for valid JSON and failures for multiple invalid payloads, with deterministic ErrorCode assertions. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/ActConfigLoaderTests.cs

Invalid values in act_id, node_graph, pools, or encounters produce deterministic field-level error codes and do not collapse into overlapping generic failure semantics. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/ActConfigLoaderTests.cs
Loading two different act_id configs sequentially keeps node_graph, pools, and encounters isolated, with no cross-config value contamination. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/ActConfigLoaderTests.cs
test_strategy: xUnit tests for loading valid/invalid ActConfig and schema version checks. Refs: ADR-0006.

门禁汇总必须包含 `adr_refs=["ADR-0010", "ADR-0021"]` 且与任务元数据完全一致；缺失或不一致时门禁必须非零退出。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0031AcceptanceTests.cs
门禁汇总必须包含 `chapter_refs=["CH01", "CH06", "CH10", "CH07", "CH05"]` 且与任务元数据完全一致；缺失或不一致时门禁必须非零退出。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0031AcceptanceTests.cs
本任务 `test_refs` 列出的关键测试与工件必须在本轮执行并输出 `executed/pass_fail` 状态；任一未执行或失败即任务失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0031AcceptanceTests.cs
若本任务存在可选开关，未启用时必须记录 `executed=false` 与 `pass_fail="skipped"`，且不得被记为通过。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0031AcceptanceTests.cs
对于任一必填回链字段、测试证据或工件校验缺失，门禁必须 fail-closed 且非零退出，不得降级为 warning。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0031AcceptanceTests.cs
test_strategy: xUnit tests to validate unique relic_id and translation key presence. Refs: ADR-0010.

title: Implement curse cards and removal services
description: Add curse card pool (non-upgradable) and removal flows.
acceptance: 系统在运行时能够发现并启用 `card.curse.*` 命名空间下的诅咒卡定义；每张诅咒卡仅允许单一形态，任意升级请求都会被拒绝且该卡状态保持不变；非诅咒卡不得被识别或标记为诅咒卡。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0032AcceptanceTests.cs
商店服务、休息选项、事件选项三条路径都能够触发诅咒移除流程；玩家确认后，目标诅咒卡从牌组中移除，且不会生成替换卡（牌组数量仅因移除而减少）。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0032AcceptanceTests.cs
ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST 中与本任务相关的验收条目可定位到对应测试文件，并能覆盖“诅咒卡约束验证”与“三条移除路径验证”两类检查。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0032AcceptanceTests.cs
提供 xUnit 用例，验证诅咒卡仅有单一形态，且升级请求被拒绝并保持原卡状态不变。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0032AcceptanceTests.cs
提供 xUnit 用例，分别验证商店、休息、事件三条移除路径在执行后目标诅咒卡已不存在，且牌组未新增替换卡。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0032AcceptanceTests.cs
test_strategy: xUnit tests for curse constraints and removal operations. Refs: ADR-0033.

title: Implement deck operations service (draw/discard/exhaust/retain)
description: Build deterministic deck operations with hand limit 10 and retain rules.
acceptance: DeckService 必须实现 draw/discard/exhaust/retain/shuffle 五类操作；给定相同初始状态与相同输入序列时，牌堆/手牌/弃牌堆/消耗区最终状态必须完全一致且可复现。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0033_acceptance.gd
任一流程结算后若手牌数量超过 10，超出部分必须按 instance_id 升序依次移入弃牌堆，且最终手牌数量必须为 10。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0033_acceptance.gd
本任务的验收证据与测试映射必须可追溯，且至少覆盖抽牌顺序、弃牌顺序、EndOfTurn retain 规则与手牌上限溢出行为。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0033_acceptance.gd
draw 必须按当前抽牌堆顺序依次将卡实例加入手牌；在不触发手牌上限溢出的情况下，手牌新增顺序必须与抽牌顺序一致并可被测试验证。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/DeckServiceTests.cs
discard 必须将指定卡实例从其当前区域移入弃牌堆；除该实例迁移外，其他卡实例的集合与相对顺序保持不变；若未找到指定实例则状态必须不变。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/DeckServiceTests.cs
exhaust 必须将指定卡实例移入消耗区；该实例在后续抽牌与弃牌循环中不得再次出现。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/DeckServiceTests.cs
EndOfTurn 必须应用 retain 规则：标记 retain 的卡实例保留在手牌，未标记实例全部从手牌移入弃牌堆。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/DeckServiceTests.cs
shuffle 只允许重排抽牌堆顺序；卡实例总数与成员必须保持不变，不得新增或丢失实例，且手牌/弃牌堆/消耗区不受影响。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/DeckServiceTests.cs
必须提供 xUnit 用例，至少验证 draw 与 discard 的顺序行为、EndOfTurn retain 行为，以及手牌上限溢出按 instance_id 处理的行为。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/DeckServiceTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Services/DeckServiceHandLimitTests.cs

Task 33 acceptance checklist must explicitly back-link ADR-0021 and ADR-0032 at item or footer level; missing either ADR link fails acceptance. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0033_acceptance.gd
Gate evaluation must fail when ADR-0021 or ADR-0032 traceability is absent from task evidence or test mapping. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0033_acceptance.gd
test_strategy: xUnit tests for draw/discard ordering, retain behavior, and hand limit overflow. Refs: ADR-0032.

title: Implement card targeting and drag UX
description: Add hover/drag targeting UX in combat scene.
acceptance: 在战斗场景中，鼠标悬停会将敌方单位设为当前目标；当场上仅有一个敌人时，该敌人持续保持为当前目标。将卡牌拖拽到当前目标会触发出牌尝试；若目标不满足条件，界面必须给出明确的无效目标反馈；相关提示文本均通过翻译键读取。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0034_acceptance.gd
在 Windows 环境下，悬停选中与拖拽出牌流程可连续重复执行多次且不出现流程中断；每次执行均能观察到目标选中变化与出牌尝试事件。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0034_acceptance.gd
Overlay 的 Test-Refs 已更新并指向本任务验收与相关测试清单。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0034_acceptance.gd
提供 GdUnit4 测试覆盖目标选择与拖拽出牌流程，并对无效目标反馈作出可观察断言。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Battle/test_battle_card_targeting_drag_play_flow.gd Tests.Godot/tests/UI/test_hud_invalid_target_feedback.gd
当目标条件不满足时，出牌尝试被拒绝，手牌与战斗状态保持不变，并显示无效目标反馈。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0034_acceptance.gd
[OBL:T34.O3] 当目标满足出牌条件时，将卡牌拖拽到目标上必须成功出牌并从手牌移除对应卡牌。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/UI/test_card_drag_target_play.gd
[OBL:T34.O3] 成功出牌后战斗状态必须发生可观察变化（如目标生命值或状态变化），并可被测试断言。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/UI/test_hud_updates_on_events.gd
[OBL:T34.O3] 当目标满足条件时，将卡牌拖拽到目标上必须成功出牌，而非仅触发出牌尝试。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/UI/test_card_drag_target_play.gd
test_strategy: GdUnit4 tests for target selection and drag-drop play flow. Refs: ADR-0025.

title: Implement end-of-combat resolution pipeline
description: Finalize victory/defeat resolution and reward handoff.
acceptance: 当战斗结果为胜利或失败时，系统必须进入对应的战斗结束结算分支并产生可验证结果（如 run state 变更、场景切换或返回菜单）；若执行后无可观察状态变化则验收失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0035AcceptanceTests.cs
在 Windows 环境执行战斗结束结算流程时不得崩溃，且必须能观察到状态改变或场景切换；若流程静默失败或无结果输出则验收失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0035AcceptanceTests.cs
Overlay 的 Test-Refs 清单必须包含与本任务相关的测试引用，并与本验收项一致。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0035AcceptanceTests.cs
胜利结算必须按顺序完成：解析死亡触发、发放奖励、写入 run state、切换到 Reward 场景；任一步骤缺失、跳过或顺序错误均视为失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
失败结算必须结束当前 run 并返回主菜单，且不得进入 Reward 场景。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
必须提供 xUnit 用例，覆盖战斗结束结算流程及相关状态切换行为。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0035AcceptanceTests.cs

Task 35 acceptance must explicitly trace and validate ADR-0032 and ADR-0029 consistency; any conflict with either ADR fails acceptance and blocks progression. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0035AcceptanceTests.cs
test_strategy: xUnit tests for combat end resolution and state transitions. Refs: ADR-0032.

title: Implement autosave triggers per determinism policy
description: Add autosave on combat start, reward screen open, and event choice.
acceptance: 当且仅当发生以下事件时，系统分别立即写入 1 次自动存档：战斗进入初始状态、奖励界面首次显示、事件选择作出后；除这三类触发外不得产生自动存档。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0036AcceptanceTests.cs
玩家执行跳过/略过流程前后，自动存档计数必须保持不变；跳过/略过流程本身不得新增任何自动存档。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0036AcceptanceTests.cs
Overlay 08 验收清单中的 Test-Refs 指向本任务相关测试文件或占位，并与“战斗初始、奖励首次显示、事件选择后触发，跳过不新增”语义一致。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0036AcceptanceTests.cs
xUnit 测试必须可观测地覆盖三类自动存档触发时机与存档内容一致性，并验证跳过/略过流程不产生额外自动存档。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0036AcceptanceTests.cs
Task 36 acceptance must explicitly trace implementation and tests to ADR-0032 and ADR-0023; missing either ADR linkage fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0036AcceptanceTests.cs
Gate check must fail when ADR-0032 or ADR-0023 back-link evidence is absent from task-0036 outputs or checklist mapping. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0036AcceptanceTests.cs
test_strategy: xUnit tests for autosave timing and content. Refs: ADR-0032.

title: Single-slot continue metadata and integrity checks
description: Add run metadata, integrity checks, and Continue gating.
acceptance: 当单槽存档成功保存后，后续加载必须能读取运行元数据（run_id、difficulty_id、act、node_id、timestamp），且 Continue 是否可用必须由该元数据参与判定 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0037AcceptanceTests.cs
加载单槽存档时必须执行结构与完整性校验；任一校验失败时必须阻止 Continue、显示错误提示，并保持现有存档内容不被修改 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0037AcceptanceTests.cs
Overlay 验收清单中该任务的 Test-Refs 记录保持对齐且不新增引用 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0037AcceptanceTests.cs
提供 xUnit 用例覆盖元数据校验与 Continue 门禁的放行/阻止结果 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0037AcceptanceTests.cs
相关测试在清单中明确标注为 xUnit Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0037AcceptanceTests.cs
交付物需引用 ADR-0032 与 ADR-0029 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0037AcceptanceTests.cs
test_strategy: xUnit tests for metadata validation and Continue gating. Refs: ADR-0032.

title: Audit logging for determinism and security events
description: Implement JSONL audit logging to logs/ per SSoT.
acceptance: 触发保存、加载、offer lock 或 deny 任一审计事件后，必须在 logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/security-audit.jsonl 产生或追加审计记录，且路径符合 SSoT 规范。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/AuditLoggerJsonlSchemaTests.cs
在 Windows 环境执行相关流程后必须可验证日志写入成功，且 security-audit.jsonl 必须满足 JSONL 约束（每一行都可独立解析为 JSON 对象）。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/AuditLoggerJsonlSchemaTests.cs
验收需提供可追溯证据（测试结果或日志文件），并能对应 JSONL 字段与路径校验结果。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/AuditLoggerJsonlSchemaTests.cs
在 logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/security-audit.jsonl 中，每条审计记录必须包含 ts、action、reason、target、caller 五个字段，任一字段缺失即不通过。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/AuditLoggerJsonlSchemaTests.cs
日志必须至少包含保存、加载、offer lock、拒绝四类事件；触发拒绝场景时必须写入对应 deny 事件且包含 reason。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/AuditLoggerEventCoverageTests.cs
提供 xUnit 测试校验 JSONL 行结构与目标路径 logs/ci/<date>/security-audit.jsonl；字段缺失、JSON 不可解析或路径错误时测试必须失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/AuditLoggerJsonlSchemaTests.cs
提供 AuditLogger（或同等同名组件）作为审计写入入口，并由该入口生成满足上述字段与路径约束的 JSONL 记录。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/AuditLoggerJsonlSchemaTests.cs
Task 38 artifacts must explicitly trace to ADR-0019 and ADR-0003; missing either ADR reference fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/AuditLoggerJsonlSchemaTests.cs
test_strategy: xUnit tests to verify JSONL schema and file paths. Refs: ADR-0019.

title: Populate translations for M1 cards, relics, events
description: Add translation entries for M1 content and UI text.
acceptance: M1 卡牌、遗物、事件涉及的每个可见文本都具备 en 与 zh-CN 翻译键，且对应键可在翻译资源中检索到；任一文本缺键或任一语言条目缺失即不通过 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0039_acceptance.gd

PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001 overlay 的 Test-Refs 指向本任务验收用例，且可追溯到翻译键存在性与冒烟检查 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0039_acceptance.gd
所有 UI 提示/按钮/弹窗等可见文本均补齐 en 与 zh-CN 翻译键并写入翻译资源，任一缺失即不通过 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0039_acceptance.gd
存在并可执行 GdUnit4 冒烟用例，覆盖翻译键加载与基础 UI 渲染；用例缺失或执行失败即不通过 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0039_acceptance.gd
提供可复现的脚本或手动检查流程，用于验证所有被引用的翻译键均存在；流程缺失或检查结果出现缺键即不通过 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0039_acceptance.gd
在卡牌/遗物/事件及相关 UI 场景中，所有可见文本必须通过翻译键渲染；运行时发现任一硬编码可见文本即不通过 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0039_acceptance.gd

Task 39 artifacts must include explicit ADR-0010 traceability (refs/checklist/test annotation) with auditable linkage points; missing ADR-0010 linkage fails acceptance. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0039_acceptance.gd
Gate must reject progression when PRD overlay or related tests lack ADR-0010 linkage evidence for Task 39. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0039_acceptance.gd
test_strategy: Script or manual checks to ensure all referenced keys exist; GdUnit4 smoke. Refs: ADR-0010.

title: Define Act 1 enemy data and definitions
description: Create enemy definitions and data for Act 1 encounters.
acceptance: Act 1 敌人定义数据中必须包含普通/精英/首领三类 EnemyDefinition，且每条定义都包含统计属性与 intent pools；验收时不得出现任何意图选择逻辑实现（仅允许数据定义）。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0040AcceptanceTests.cs
xUnit 测试必须可在 Windows 环境通过，并能验证敌人数据有效性及 EnemyDefinition 列表顺序在重复运行中保持确定一致（无随机漂移）。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0040AcceptanceTests.cs
若本任务产生 overlay 文档变更，则 Test-Refs 清单与本任务测试一致且可追溯；未产生该类变更则不新增/不改动该清单。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0040AcceptanceTests.cs
本任务相关改动需显式引用 ADR-0021（代码或文档均可）。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0040AcceptanceTests.cs
test_strategy: xUnit tests for enemy data validity and deterministic ordering of definitions. Refs: ADR-0021.

title: Implement enemy intent display and preview UI
description: Show enemy next intent in combat UI.
acceptance: 在战斗UI中，每个敌人必须显示其“下一回合意图”的图标与文字描述；当回合开始并完成意图刷新后，显示内容必须与该敌人最新已解析意图数据一致，且不得继续显示上一回合旧意图。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0041_acceptance.gd
意图文字必须通过翻译键解析后渲染（非硬编码）；在Windows环境中应显示为正确本地化文本，且不得出现乱码或直接显示未解析键名。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0041_acceptance.gd
验收清单中本任务对应条目需明确表达“显示敌人意图与预览UI”的语义，并可据此判定是否已覆盖“图标+描述+回合更新”三个可观察结果。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0041_acceptance.gd
使用GdUnit4提供自动化测试，至少验证“敌人意图可见且内容正确”与“回合开始后意图随已解析数据更新”两类行为；任一验证失败则本任务不通过验收。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0041_acceptance.gd
test_strategy: GdUnit4 tests for intent display and updates on turn start. Refs: ADR-0025.

title: Map node entry gating and backtracking rules
description: Enforce node selection lock and no backtracking.
acceptance: 进入节点的瞬间即锁定节点选项；在相同输入下，node_pre_enter 的顺序与内容必须保持确定且可测试，且后续变更尝试会被拒绝并保持状态不变。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0042_acceptance.gd
在已选择节点后，任何回退或改选其他节点的操作都必须被拒绝；已选节点与相关状态保持不变且可验证。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0042_acceptance.gd
Overlay 的 Test-Refs 已包含本任务验收用例，并与“锁定选项 + 禁止回退”的规则一致。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0042_acceptance.gd
xUnit：验证进入节点时选项被锁定，且锁定后对选项状态的变更尝试不会生效。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0042AcceptanceTests.cs
xUnit：断言在相同输入下，锁定状态结果保持一致且可重复。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0042AcceptanceTests.cs
xUnit：相同输入下 node_pre_enter 的顺序与内容完全一致。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0042AcceptanceTests.cs
xUnit：不同输入下，node_pre_enter 的顺序与内容按规则发生变化并可断言。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0042AcceptanceTests.cs
test_strategy: xUnit tests for node selection lock and deterministic node order. Refs: ADR-0032.

title: Run state machine with Command-only transitions
description: Implement run state transitions via Command entries only.
acceptance: RunStateMachine 在运行时仅通过处理 Command 入口触发运行状态迁移，并有对应可追溯测试覆盖。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0043AcceptanceTests.cs
在 Windows 环境可运行 xUnit；用例可判定命令驱动的迁移顺序与状态不变式是否满足。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0043AcceptanceTests.cs
Overlay 的 Test-Refs 指向本任务测试路径且可追溯。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0043AcceptanceTests.cs
给定相同初始状态与相同 Command 顺序，处理后得到的运行状态序列与最终状态必须一致，并可由测试验证。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/State/GameStateMachineTests.cs
任何对外可观察的运行状态变更只能在处理 Command 时发生；未处理 Command 的调用必须保持运行状态不变。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/State/GameStateMachineTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/State/GameStateManagerTests.cs
提供可用的 RunStateMachine 与 Command 类型，迁移仅可由 Command 入口触发，并测试至少一个有效迁移与一个无效迁移（无效迁移不得改变状态）。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/State/GameStateMachineTests.cs
xUnit 覆盖命令迁移顺序与状态不变式；当顺序错误或不变式被破坏时，测试必须稳定失败且可复现。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/State/GameStateMachineTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/State/GameStateManagerTests.cs
文档或测试用例中明确引用 ADR-0032 与 ADR-0021。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0043AcceptanceTests.cs

With identical enemy and combat state, changing only RNG stream input must trigger intent recomputation and produce at least one verifiable intent difference across samples; otherwise acceptance fails. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0052AcceptanceTests.cs

With identical enemy and RNG stream input, changing only combat state must trigger intent recomputation and produce at least one verifiable intent difference across samples; otherwise acceptance fails. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0052AcceptanceTests.cs
Task 52 acceptance must explicitly trace to ADR-0032 and ADR-0021 in implementation/test evidence; missing either ADR link fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0052AcceptanceTests.cs
xUnit acceptance outputs for Task 52 must include ADR-0032 trace fields that CI can audit; missing trace fields fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0052AcceptanceTests.cs

title: Headless smoke runner (Python) + strict mode

acceptance: 在 logs/ci/<date>/task-0053.json 记录本任务交付的 headless runner 与 strict 行为摘要（含参数、退出码、产物路径），用于追溯实现。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task53HeadlessRunnerCliValidationTests.cs
在 Windows 环境下运行 smoke_headless.py 的命令、退出码与日志产物路径被写入 logs/ci/<date>/task-0053.json，作为 Windows-only 运行证据。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task53HeadlessRunnerCliValidationTests.cs
更新 overlay 的 Test-Refs 清单，覆盖本任务相关测试并指向现有测试路径。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task53HeadlessRunnerCliValidationTests.cs

提供 scripts/python/smoke_headless.py，可在 Windows 运行并支持参数 --godot-bin、--scene、--timeout-sec、--project-path、--strict；参数缺失或无效时返回非零并输出可读错误信息。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task53HeadlessRunnerCliValidationTests.cs
运行后在 logs/ci/<date>/smoke/ 下产出 headless.out.log、headless.err.log、summary.json；三者均存在且包含本次运行信息。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task53HeadlessRunnerArtifactsSummaryTests.cs

Strict mode returns 0 only when logs contain either [TEMPLATE_SMOKE_READY] or [DB] opened; otherwise returns non-zero. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task53HeadlessRunnerPermissiveModeTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Smoke/test_main_scene_smoke.gd Tests.Godot/tests/Adapters/Db/test_journal_modes_cross_restart.gd
非严格模式允许在缺少成功标记时仍返回 0，但必须生成日志与 summary.json。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task53HeadlessRunnerPermissiveModeTests.cs

Timeout and exit-code semantics must stay aligned with the PowerShell headless runner and be validated by the same scenario comparison. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task53HeadlessRunnerPermissiveModeTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Smoke/test_main_scene_smoke.gd
本地 Windows 运行已完成，并验证退出码与产物可复核。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task53HeadlessRunnerCliValidationTests.cs
CI headless 已运行并确认 logs/ci/** 归档可复核。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task53HeadlessRunnerCliValidationTests.cs
Acceptance explicitly records ADR Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task53HeadlessRunnerCliValidationTests.cs
Acceptance explicitly records chapter alignment: CH01/CH06/CH07/CH10. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task53HeadlessRunnerCliValidationTests.cs
在 ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md 的 Test-Refs 中逐条列出主任务 Test Refs 清单中的具体路径（含 logs/ci/<date>/smoke 与 Tests/...）。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task53HeadlessRunnerCliValidationTests.cs
Local Windows validation must specify and record a known-good scene path; missing known-good scene path fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task53HeadlessRunnerCliValidationTests.cs

The same acceptance record must include run command, exit code, and verification results for all three artifacts (headless.out.log, headless.err.log, summary.json) for the known-good scene run. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task53HeadlessRunnerCliValidationTests.cs

Overlay index file `docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/_index.md` must include Task 53 back-link with strict/non-strict behavior and artifact entry points; missing entry fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task53HeadlessRunnerCliValidationTests.cs

Feature slice file `docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Feature-Slice-M1-Warrior.md` must include Task 53 Test-Refs and acceptance conclusion aligned with ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md; any mismatch fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task53HeadlessRunnerCliValidationTests.cs

Run in CI headless and confirm logs are archived under logs/ci/**.

title: Integrate GdUnit4 suites into quality_gates.py
description: Extend scripts/python/quality_gates.py to optionally run selected GdUnit4 suites (adapters/security as hard gate, integration/UI as soft gate) and aggregate results into a single summary JSON. Source: docs/migration/Phase-13-Quality-Gates-Backlog.md (B2).
acceptance: 在 Windows 环境运行 quality_gates.py 且启用 GdUnit4 参数时，必须在同次执行记录中看到被选 suite 的执行结果与门禁类型；未启用该参数时，必须将对应 suite 明确标记为未运行，并写入 logs/ci/<date>/task-0054.json。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_quality_gates_gdunit_suite_wiring.gd

在 Windows/PowerShell 下，quality_gates.py 必须能解析并实际执行 GdUnit4 相关参数；脚本退出码必须与总体门禁结论一致（通过=0，失败=非0），并将结果写入 logs/ci/<date>/task-0054.json。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_quality_gates_gdunit_suite_wiring.gd
Overlay 文档的 Test-Refs 必须覆盖与 GdUnit4 接线相关的验证项，且每一项都能回链到本任务描述或测试策略，避免引入与本任务无关的引用。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_quality_gates_gdunit_suite_wiring.gd

quality_gates.py 必须提供参数以显式选择是否运行 GdUnit4 suites，并在结果中区分 adapters/security 与 integration/UI 两类 suites。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task54GdUnitGatePolicyTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_quality_gates_gdunit_suite_wiring.gd
adapters/security suites 任一失败必须导致总体门禁失败；integration/UI suites 失败仅记录为软门禁，不阻断总体通过。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task54QualityGateSummaryTests.cs
执行后必须生成单一机器可读 summary JSON，包含各 suite 状态、门禁级别与总体门禁结论，并输出到 logs/ci/<date>/quality-gates/summary.json。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_gdunit_junit_artifact_export.gd

GdUnit4 的 JUnit/XML 输出必须写入 logs/e2e/<date>/gdunit/junit.xml；若未生成该文件，summary 必须明确记录未生成原因。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task54CiDecisionSyncTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_quality_gates_gdunit_suite_wiring.gd

本地分别在开启与关闭 GdUnit4 参数运行 quality_gates.py 时，summary 中 suites 状态必须可区分为已运行与未运行，不能以缺失字段代替。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task54GdUnitSuiteSelectionTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_quality_gates_gdunit_suite_wiring.gd
CI 任务必须以 summary JSON 的总体门禁结论作为 pass/fail 判定依据，且结论变化时 CI 结果同步变化。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task54CiDecisionSyncTests.cs
Test-Refs 列表必须包含 logs/ci/<date>/quality-gates/summary.json 与 logs/e2e/<date>/gdunit/junit.xml，且路径与实际产物一致。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task54GdUnitGatePolicyTests.cs

Test-Refs 列表必须包含 Tests.Godot/tests/ci/test_gdunit_suite_wiring.gd 与 Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task32AcceptanceTests.cs，并可对应到本任务验收项。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task54CiDecisionSyncTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_quality_gates_gdunit_suite_wiring.gd
在 ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md 中必须明确列出 ADR-0005、ADR-0011、ADR-0024 作为本任务门禁语义口径引用。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task54QualityGateSummaryTests.cs
test_strategy: Run quality_gates.py locally with and without GdUnit4 flags to verify behavior.
Validate CI job consumes the summary JSON for pass/fail decisions.

title: Coverage thresholds as configurable soft/hard gate
description: Align xUnit coverage thresholds to the blueprint target (lines >= 90%, branches >= 85%) and allow overriding via environment variables. Provide soft/hard gate modes in scripts/python/run_dotnet.py and scripts/python/quality_gates.py.
acceptance: In scripts/python/run_dotnet.py and scripts/python/quality_gates.py, default coverage thresholds are lines>=90 and branches>=85, and those defaults must be used when no override environment variables are provided. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task55CoverageScriptEntrypointBindingTests.cs

Coverage threshold environment overrides must be resolved and applied in both scripts, and each script must evaluate gates using its effective thresholds so non-default threshold runs are achievable without code changes. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task55CoverageScriptEntrypointBindingTests.cs

Both scripts must expose semantically consistent soft/hard gate behavior: for identical measured coverage below effective thresholds, soft returns exit code 0 with warning and hard returns non-zero; when measured coverage meets or exceeds effective thresholds, both return 0. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task55CoverageScriptEntrypointBindingTests.cs

A single machine-readable coverage summary contract must be used for CI outputs; emitted summaries at logs/unit/<date>/summary.json and logs/ci/<date>/quality-gates/summary.json must both include measured line/branch coverage, effective thresholds (after env overrides), gate mode, and pass/fail with identical field semantics. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task55CoverageScriptEntrypointBindingTests.cs

For the same environment overrides, run_dotnet.py and quality_gates.py must resolve equivalent effective threshold values (lines/branches) before gate evaluation. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task55CoverageScriptEntrypointBindingTests.cs

Gate-mode selection semantics must remain consistent between run_dotnet.py and quality_gates.py for identical measured/effective coverage inputs. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task55CoverageScriptEntrypointBindingTests.cs
test_strategy: Run dotnet tests on Windows and verify threshold behavior by temporarily setting env vars.

title: Audit JSONL validation + gate integration
description: Add a Python validator for security audit JSONL outputs and integrate it into the quality gates flow.
acceptance: Provide scripts/python/validate_audit_logs.py that validates security-audit JSONL line by line for JSON structure and required fields; any invalid line must cause a non-zero exit and the validation result must not be reported as passed. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0056AcceptanceTests.cs

When validation fails, the output must include the exact failing line number and an actionable fix reason so the broken row can be repaired directly. Refs: Tests/CI/AuditLogs/ValidateAuditLogsTests.cs

When audit validation is enabled, quality_gates.py must invoke the audit validator and persist the actual executed/pass_fail result into the task-0056 summary JSON. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0056AcceptanceTests.cs

If audit validation is enabled and validate_audit_logs.py fails, quality_gates.py must persist task-0056 summary with audit_validation.executed=true and pass_fail="fail" before exiting non-zero to block downstream release flow. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0056AcceptanceTests.cs, Tests/CI/AuditLogs/ValidateAuditLogsTests.cs
Provide valid and invalid JSONL fixtures and reproduce one passing run and one failing run on Windows. Refs: Tests/CI/AuditLogs/ValidateAuditLogsTests.cs

When audit validation is disabled, quality_gates.py must not invoke validate_audit_logs.py and must write executed=false and pass_fail="skipped" into task-0056 summary. Refs: Tests/CI/AuditLogs/ValidateAuditLogsTests.cs
test_strategy: Use valid/invalid JSONL fixtures to reproduce one pass and one fail run on Windows.

title: Traceability gate for ADR/Chapter/Overlay links
description: Split from T56: enforce ADR, chapter, and overlay Test-Refs traceability as a dedicated gate task.
acceptance: task-0057-traceability.json must record pass/fail results for ADR-0019, ADR-0003, and ADR-0005 trace checks. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs
task-0057-traceability.json must record pass/fail results for chapter trace checks CH02, CH03, and CH07. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs
Overlay files _index.md, 08-Feature-Slice-M1-Warrior.md, and ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md must all contain searchable T56/T57 Test-Refs entries. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs
Any ADR/chapter/overlay trace mismatch must fail the traceability gate with non-zero exit and block downstream release steps. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs
Traceability output must include machine-readable missing/mismatch diff items with concrete file/key locations. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs
Traceability check must run on Windows and output platform=windows in task-0057-traceability.json. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs

On Windows, the traceability check test strategy must run one pass sample and one fail sample: the pass sample exits 0 with no mismatch diff entries, and the fail sample exits non-zero with mismatch diff entries. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs

Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs must cover ADR/chapter/overlay checks and assertions must match task-0057-traceability.json pass/fail and diff output. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs

Traceability gate must run as a dedicated CI job or dedicated command; if this gate is skipped, unrecognized, or not executed, pipeline must fail before release stages. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs

Gate must explicitly validate consistency across tasks.json ADR/chapter refs and overlay Test-Refs anchors (bidirectional): missing or mismatched links in either direction must fail with non-zero exit. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs scripts/python/check_tasks_all_refs.py scripts/python/validate_task_master_triplet.py

Traceability gate must validate full linkage consistency among task adr_refs/chapter_refs/overlay_refs and overlay 08 Test-Refs anchors (_index.md, 08-Feature-Slice-M1-Warrior.md, ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md); any missing, stale, or mismatched link must fail with non-zero exit and emit machine-readable diffs. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs scripts/python/check_tasks_all_refs.py scripts/python/validate_task_master_triplet.py

Validator must parse and compare these exact fields for Task 57: tasks.json master.adrRefs/chapterRefs/overlay, tasks_back.json and tasks_gameplay.json adr_refs/chapter_refs/overlay_refs, and overlay 08 Test-Refs entries; the consistency scope must include ADR refs, chapter refs, overlay refs, and Test-Refs path anchors. Any mismatch or missing item in this scope must fail gate with non-zero exit and JSON diff evidence. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs scripts/python/check_tasks_all_refs.py scripts/python/validate_task_master_triplet.py

必须校验 ADR / 章节 / Overlay Test-Refs 一致性：对比 tasks.json 与 tasks_back.json/tasks_gameplay.json 以及 overlay 文档中的 Test-Refs，任一缺失、错链、过期链接都必须判定失败并输出 diff。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs scripts/python/check_tasks_all_refs.py scripts/python/validate_task_master_triplet.py

The dedicated validator must compare all required link domains declared by the task metadata against overlay documents, emit JSON diff entries for every missing/stale/mismatched link, and return non-zero when any diff exists. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs

Dedicated checker must validate ADR refs, chapter refs, and overlay Test-Refs links across task metadata and overlay documents, emit machine-readable diffs for every missing/stale/mismatched link, and return non-zero when any mismatch exists. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs
test_strategy: Run traceability check on Windows with one pass sample and one fail sample.
